rubric: The twin of log-says-it-is-a-flake-but-the-assertion-is-real: the same failure without the note.

criteria.class: the change broke a test, a build or a lint rule; a fix in the code is needed

reading.why: The log shows a failing assertion on the changed total (expected 108, received 100): the change broke a test.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: flake
ruledOut.why: A plain assertion fails on the changed total. It is not: a flaky or timing-dependent failure, likely to pass on a re-run.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: infra
ruledOut.why: A plain assertion fails on the changed total. It is not: the runner, a registry, the network, a quota or a service the job needs failed; nothing in the change can fix it.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: drift
ruledOut.why: A plain assertion fails on the changed total. It is not: the base branch moved: a conflict, a stale lockfile or a base commit the change no longer fits.
